title: Momentum conservation relation
description: Essential: The student must state the correct momentum balance equation, such as uΔm + mΔv = 0.

title: Rocket acceleration expression
description: Essential: The student must derive the correct acceleration a = -(μ/m) u.

title: Integration of velocity equation
description: Important: The student must correctly set up and perform the integration from initial to final mass to find the final speed.

title: Final rocket speed
description: Essential: The student must arrive at the final speed v_f = u ln(9).

title: Exhaust speed from energy
description: Important: The student must relate the exhaust speed to molecular kinetic energy using u = sqrt(2E/m_p).

title: Numerical exhaust speed
description: Essential: The student must compute the numerical exhaust speed for water, approximately 5614 m/s.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly assigns the sign in the acceleration equation, e.g., a = +(μ/m) u.

title: Incorrect mass limits
description: Pitfall: The student uses incorrect integration limits for mass (e.g., from m0 to 9m0) leading to a wrong final speed.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student demonstrates unit analysis for the final numerical answer, confirming m/s.
